title: Reconcile the vitest include roster with lane-smoke's three-pattern pin (f28cfe4 fallout)
description:
Filed by governor-7211ec87 2026-08-21 10:26Z from worker-40cfc767's attributed measurement (msg-fd3f1653, #general). Commit f28cfe4 "fix(tools): bind both importers to the store's per-commit cap" (2026-08-21 13:19:43 +0300) added a FOURTH pattern `tools/**/*.test.ts` to the root vitest.config.ts include list. tests/security/lane-smoke.security.ts:197 pins that list to EXACTLY three: expect(block.include).toStrictEqual(["adapters/**/*.test.ts","packages/**/*.test.ts","tests/**/*.test.ts"]) — the pin exists so hostile files are never silently swept into regression evidence. The pin now reds.

Attribution (worker-measured, unambiguous): `git log -S'tools/**/*.test.ts' -- vitest.config.ts` names f28cfe4 and nothing else; the worker's baseline at 1558a61 had lane-smoke GREEN; f28cfe4 also added tools/import/import-shadow.test.ts, which runs fine — only the pin objects.

DECISION FOR THE PLANNER (both legitimate; measure, don't assume): (a) the include change is intended — extend the lane-smoke pin to the four patterns AND verify tools/** contains no hostile/security fixture files the pin's rationale protects against (that verification is the actual deliverable, not the one-line pin edit); or (b) the include change is unintended scope — revert the vitest.config.ts hunk and give tools/import/import-shadow.test.ts a home under an already-included root, coordinating with f28cfe4's author lane. RE-MEASURE AT HEAD first: the conflict may already be resolved.

HAZARD: `pnpm test:security` runs in NO other gate (recorded fleet memory) — this red is invisible until someone runs the lane deliberately. Three other security files are red on the FOREIGN a92544f nodeAuthority fixture cause owned by task-8c7e6ce4 — do not absorb those; baseline-attribute.
definitionOfDone: The vitest include roster and lane-smoke's pin agree, by whichever branch the measurement supports, with the branch decision and its evidence recorded

If branch (a): the pin covers all four patterns and the tools/** sweep is verified hostile-fixture-free with the verification recorded; if branch (b): the include hunk is reverted and the orphaned tools test relocates to an included root, its counts proven still executed (nonzero)
pnpm test:security shows lane-smoke.security.ts green; the three a92544f-caused foreign reds are baseline-attributed verbatim if still present, never absorbed
Explicit-pathspec commit touching only this row's owned files

(3) The red is live and exact: `npx vitest run --config tests/security/vitest.config.ts lane-smoke` -> 'Tests 1 failed | 16 passed (17)', the single failure at lane-smoke.security.ts:197 toStrictEqual missing only "tools/**/*.test.ts" — this IS the TDD red for this row; no other site pins the roster (repo-wide grep for the first include literal hits only lane-smoke.security.ts:198). Re-run the enumeration and the focused red at your HEAD; if either changed (e.g. the conflict already resolved, or a hostile-suffix file appeared under tools/), STOP and re-decide per the task description before editing.
